sections.shortTitle: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order 1994
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PRESIDENT'S ORDER I OF 1994
PRESIDENT'S ORDER I OF 1994
SALARY OF JUDGES OF SUPERIOR
COURTS ORDER, 1994
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Order may be called the Salary of Judges of
Superior Courts Order, 1994.
(2) It shall come into force at once and shall be
deemed to have taken effect on the first day of June, 1994.

sections.shortTitle: Salary of Judges of Superior Courts Order 1994
sections.description:
Salary

PRESIDENT'S ORDER I OF 1994
PRESIDENT'S ORDER I OF 1994
SALARY OF JUDGES OF SUPERIOR
COURTS ORDER, 1994
2. Salary.‑‑(1)
The salary to be paid per mensem to the Chief Justice of Pakistan shall be
Rs.20,250 and that to be so paid to every other Judge of the Supreme Court
shall be Rs.18,000.
(2) The salary to be paid per mensem to the Chief
Justice of a High Court shall be Rs.17,000 and that to be so paid to every
other Judge of a High Court shall be Rs.15,500.
